author: Matthew Adam
title: Petey Halpin scores three times in win
desc: Petey Halpin went 1-for-2 in a 4-3 win over the White Sox in 10 innings with three runs scored.
impact: Halpin wasn't part of the original starting lineup, but he pinch ran for David Fry and wound up crossing the plate three times. After Wednesday's win, Halpin is batting .188 with no home runs, one RBI, eight runs scored, and two stolen bases across 26 games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Kahlil Watson Drives In Three as Guardians Squeak Past Sox
desc: Kahlil Watson went 2-for-4 in Wednesday's 10-inning, 4-3 win over the White Sox with a walk and three RBI.
impact: After Wednesday's win over the White Sox, Watson is slashing .238/.273/.381 with one home run, six RBI, one run scored, and one stolen base across seven games. He had an excellent three-game series against Chicago, posting five hits and driving in six runs.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Cade Smith coughs up late lead, tagged with blown save
desc: Cade Smith took the loss in Wednesday's 4-3 win over the White Sox.
impact: Smith allowed two earned runs on three hits and a walk while striking out one, taking a blown save. After Wednesday's win over the White Sox, Smith now has a 3.22 ERA and 1.18 WHIP with 24 saves and three blown saves across 34 appearances. Smith has posted two straight rough appearances, allowing five earned runs across 3 1/3 innings of work. The Cleveland closer will look to get back on track next time out.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Tanner Bibee pitches well in No-Decision
desc: Tanner Bibee allowed zero earned runs on three hits and one walk while striking out three over six innings in Wednesday's 4-3 win over the White Sox in 10 innings.
impact: Bibee did his part, but the win column still refuses to cooperate. He now carries a 3.78 ERA and 1.14 WHIP with a 2-8 record and 81 strikeouts through 17 starts this season. Bibee will be back on the mound on Tuesday against the Rangers.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Joe Ryan's nine Ks weren't enough as Dodgers tag him for four
desc: Joe Ryan allowed four earned runs on eight hits and one walk while striking out nine over six innings in Wednesday's 4-3 loss to the Dodgers.
impact: Ryan got the whiffs, but not the results on Wednesday. After the outing, he owns a 3.18 ERA and 1.03 WHIP with a 5-4 record and 108 strikeouts across 17 starts. His next start will be Tuesday against Houston.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Brooks Lee swipes a bag despite quiet loss
desc: Brooks Lee went 1-for-2 in a 4-3 loss to the Dodgers on Wednesday with one run scored, two walks, one stolen base, and one strikeout.
impact: Lee did what he could in a tight one, but the Twins still came up short. After Wednesday's loss, Lee is batting .240 with 13 home runs, four stolen bases, 45 RBI, and 38 runs scored across 78 games. He is hitting .250 with two homers and six RBI over his past seven contests.

author: David Leisering
title: Jimmy Herget picks up second save of season Wednesday
desc: Jimmy Herget pitched a perfect ninth inning on Wednesday, striking out two, to earn the save in an 8-6 win over the Red Sox.
impact: Herget needed only 11 pitches to retire the side in order on Wednesday, striking out two batters in the process. It was his second save of the year with his other coming on April 1 against Toronto. In his three appearances since coming off the IL, Herget has struck out six batters and allowed only two hits and a walk in 3.1 scoreless innings. Seven different Rockies have recorded saves this season with four by Victor Vodnik being tops on the team. Your guess is as good as ours when it comes to saves in Colorado, but Herget has certainly looked the part since his return.

author: David Leisering
title: Cole Carrigg plates three in win over Red Sox
desc: Cole Carrigg had two hits and drove in three runs in five trips to the plate on Wednesday as the Rockies beat the Red Sox, 8-6.
impact: Carrigg had an RBI single in the seventh and then added an insurance run in the eighth with a run-scoring double. He added a sacrifice fly in the third for his other RBI on the night. The rookie is off to an intriguing start for fantasy purposes, batting .271 (13-for-48) with three home runs and 11 runs batted in through his first 14 games. While he has spent most of his time in center, Carrigg has also appeared in two games at shortstop which would add to his intrigue if he gets position eligibility there as well.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Yandy Diaz records four hits Wednesday
desc: Yandy Diaz went 4-for-5 with one RBI and a run scored in Wednesday's 5-3 win over the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Diaz collected four singles on Wednesday, though he was only able to score once. He has been outstanding in June, slashing .388/.468/.475, and his .332 batting average on the season ranks third among all qualified hitters.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Chandler Simpson steals two bases Wednesday
desc: Chandler Simpson went 1-for-2 with a walk and two stolen bases in Wednesday's 5-3 win over the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Simpson singled in the fifth inning and swiped second base, then drew a walk in the eighth and stole his second bag of the day, his 19th of the season. He has been an excellent fantasy contributor lately despite the lack of power, posting a .370 OBP and five stolen bases over his last seven games.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Griffin Jax records season-high seven strikeouts Wednesday
desc: Jax allowed two runs, none earned, on five hits and two walks while striking out seven across five innings in Wednesday's 5-3 win over the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Jax showcased what he can do fully stretched out as a starter on Wednesday, tossing a season-high 88 pitches and seven strikeouts. He has been terrific in the rotation this season, posting a 2.40 ERA and 1.20 WHIP across 11 starts. His next scheduled outing is on Tuesday in a rematch against the Kansas City Royals.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Bryan Baker notches 20th save of season Wednesday
desc: Bryan Baker allowed one run on one hit while striking out two batters in the ninth inning of Wednesday's 5-3 win over the Kansas City Royals to earn his 20th save of the season.
impact: Baker surrendered a one-out home run to Josh Rojas, snapping a streak of 12 straight outings without allowing a run. He bounced back to retire the next two batters and pick up his fourth save of June. Baker has been stellar this season, posting a 2.01 ERA and 0.89 WHIP while ranking third in saves.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Pete Fairbanks notches save Wednesday
desc: Pete Fairbanks allowed one run on one hit and no walks in the ninth inning of Wednesday's 4-2 win over the Texas Rangers, picking up his 12th save of the season.
impact: Fairbanks surrendered a solo shot to Joc Pederson before retiring the next three batters. He has allowed three runs over his last two appearances, but is a perfect 6-for-6 in save opportunities in June. Despite his inconsistencies, he remains the closer and is worth adding if in need of saves. However, fantasy managers should be mindful of his 6.75 ERA on the season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Otto Lopez hits two-run homer in win Wednesday
desc: Otto Lopez went 2-for-3 with a home run, a walk, two runs scored and two RBI in Wednesday's 4-2 win over the Texas Rangers.
impact: Lopez has recorded multi-hit games in three straight contests, with two extra-base hits during that span. The league leader in batting average continues to make his case for an All-Star selection, slashing .365/.409/.541 in June with 10 extra-base hits and six stolen bases.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Eury Perez throws 68 pitches in return Wednesday
desc: Eury Perez allowed one run on three hits and one walk while striking out one across 4.2 innings in Wednesday's 4-2 win over the Texas Rangers.
impact: Perez made his return to the mound after being sidelined for roughly a month with a right gracilis strain. Despite recording just one strikeout, he looked sharp across 68 pitches, surrendering only a solo home run to Wyatt Langford in the fourth inning. He also touched 99.6 mph, a reassuring sign that his velocity remains intact. On the season, Perez owns a 4.41 ERA and 1.22 WHIP with 73 strikeouts across 67.1 innings in 13 starts. He is lined up to take the mound on Tuesday against the Colorado Rockies.
